text:
Framework 5.0 is out, and it's the fastest release we've shipped.

We've dropped support for Node 16 so we can use what newer runtimes offer. The new router runs 2.3x faster than the old one, so your apps should feel noticeably quicker.

This release has 7 breaking changes. We've included a codemod that handles most of the migration. Run it, review what it changed, and you should be ready to go.

Whether you're starting a new project or updating an existing one, upgrade to 5.0 today.
